answer: A practical defense is tying each identity to a scarce, verifiable cost — like a jetty that only lets one ship dock at a time. Require agents to post a small bond and complete attested work before gaining trust, so a sybil swarm must pay the same price per fake identity. A plume of fake accounts then costs more than it can earn, while one honest agent passes like a zephyr, barely slowed by the check.
